ns2:course.label: College Writing II
ns2:course.description: Continued instruction in structuring argumentative essays: concentrates on evidence, claims, warrants, issues, discussion, and elements of style. Second term of a two-term sequence (RHET 101/100 - RHET 102/100) that fulfills the campus Composition I general education requirement. Credit is not given for both RHET 102 and either RHET 104 or RHET 105. Prerequisite: RHET 101; concurrent registration in RHET 100.
